duration: Confidentiality obligation of 3 years from the date of signing. NOTE: This is the correct duration per the prevailing English version; the Arabic version incorrectly states 5 years (see data/ground_truth/discrepancies.json).

financial_value.payment_terms: Not applicable — non-monetary confidentiality agreement. A liquidated damages penalty applies in case of breach (see penalty_clauses).

termination_clauses: Terminates upon expiry of the confidentiality period, or by 15 days' written notice from either party to end discussions.
penalty_clauses: Liquidated damages of USD 25,000 payable in the event of a breach of confidentiality.
governing_law: Laws of the State of Qatar.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the English version shall prevail.
